description: Stage 1 mixed-convention prompt comparison on the frozen 12-file validation split. Do not execute until approved. Do not compute WLA.

frozen_prompts.note: V1/V2/V5 received the exact PR #4 rule corrections. V3 and V4 were already identical and were not edited. Do not change these files during Stage 1.

prompts.strategy: detailed rules with six few-shot examples

cost_estimate.source: Pilot V5×hard_02 actual usage scaled to 12 files; OpenAI list prices; assumed automatic prefix cache after the first file of each prompt×model
notes: Full-transcript JSON batch: 1 request per transcript.
Pilot cells gpt-4o_V5_hard_02 and gpt-5.6-luna_V5_hard_02 count toward Stage 1 if settings stay frozen.
SDK retries may increase billed requests.
First request per prompt showed cached_tokens=0; later files should hit the automatic prefix cache.

execution_notes: Do not run paid APIs until this dry-run plan is approved.
Pair gold by C/P/A speech-line position; skip SALT $ / + / = lines. PromptTester.load_transcript currently counts headers and matches keys by dict, which is unsafe for V3.1.
Queueing a Super Mode batch was not done, to avoid accidental spend.
Reserved 18 families stay unused in Stage 1.
Headline metric is micro F1 pooled over the 12 files for each model x prompt cell.

optimization.prompt_caching: OpenAI automatic prefix cache on frozen system prompt (>=1024 tokens)
optimization.concurrency: 3-5 in flight for the full run
